title: Especialista de Pricing
description:
Como Especialista de Pricing , você atuará como um parceiro estratégico da área comercial, sendo o ponto focal para a definição e execução da estratégia de preços. Sua missão será equilibrar a equação entre competitividade, cobertura de estoque e rentabilidade (margem), garantindo que as campanhas da Privalia sejam atrativas para o consumidor e sustentáveis para o negócio. Você será o guardião das ferramentas de precificação, realizando simulações complexas e testes para otimizar o revenue management .


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar como o guardião da ferramenta de pricing, garantindo a integridade do carregamento de dados e a correta parametrização das regras de negócio;
  • Definir a precificação tática por campanha, estabelecendo faixas de desconto e estruturas de preços (markups/markdowns) alinhadas aos objetivos comerciais;
  • Realizar simulações de margem projetada e monitorar o trade-off entre cobertura de estoque (giro) vs. margem, propondo ajustes para maximizar o resultado final;
  • Desenvolver e sugerir estratégias de alavancagem de vendas, como criação de Bundles (kits), descontos progressivos e incentivos por meio de pagamento;
  • Realizar o mapeamento constante da concorrência e monitoramento de preços, considerando a visão de "preço final" (Preço do produto + Frete) para garantir competitividade real na ponta;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de testes A/B e validação de hipóteses visando a otimização de KPIs críticos do negócio, sintetizando os impactos financeiros em reports gerenciais.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação Completa (Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Estatística ou áreas correlatas);
  • Forte conhecimento em matemática financeira e conceitos de varejo/e-commerce (Margem, Markup, GMV, Giro de Estoque, Elasticidade);
  • Domínio avançado de Excel;
  • Domínio em ferramentas de visualização de dados (PowerBI, Tableau) para monitoramento de KPIs;
  • Domínio em SQL;
  • Perfil analítico com foco em resolução de problemas;
  • Inglês ou Espanhol intermediário;
  • Diferencial: Experiência com ferramentas de precificação e noções de programação (Python ou R).


O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído, sem política de dress code e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: Gerente Arquitetura Digital
description:
Prazer, somos a Claro!


Aqui, temos um grande time que faz tudo acontecer! É com o esforço e a dedicação de cada uma de nossas Pessoas que somos hoje referência no que fazemos, atuando unidos no nosso propósito, que é “Conectar para uma vida mais divertida e produtiva”.


Somamos todas as tecnologias para criar a melhor e mais completa infraestrutura de conectividade do País. Somos multicampeões confirmado pelo Speedtest como Internet móvel mais rápida e estável e com rede wi-fi mais estável do Brasil, entre tantos outros reconhecimentos. Também somos a 5º marca mais valiosa do Brasil (BrandZ).


Estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos.


E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários! Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças (Claro pay) e muito mais! Temos presença aeroespacial (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel) e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio e outros. Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e o ecossistema de inovação, que é o beOn , o hub de inovação da Claro e Embratel.

Sustentabilidade é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro , conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.


E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!


Como será o seu dia a dia?


Governança e Estratégia Tecnologica

  • Definir e implementar o modelo de governança tecnológica corporativa de acordo com as boas práticas do mercado
  • Criar mecanismos formais de tomada de decisão técnica (Architecture Board, ADRs, Tech Radar).
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para adoção, evolução e descontinuação de tecnologias.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre estratégia de tecnologia e objetivos de negócio.
  • Criar indicadores de maturidade técnica e acompanhar sua evolução.

Arquitetura e Padrões Técnicos

  • Definir padrões arquiteturais para frontend, mobile, backend, APIs, mensageria e cloud.
  • Criar arquiteturas de referência (blueprints) para acelerar novos projetos.
  • Avaliar tecnologias emergentes e orientar sua adoção de forma sustentável.
  • Garantir consistência técnica entre squads e BUs.
  • Apoiar decisões críticas de arquitetura em projetos estratégicos.

Engenharia e Processos

  • Liderar a implementação de pipelines de CI/CD padronizados.
  • Estruturar práticas de DevSecOps e automação de segurança.
  • Definir padrões de testes (unitários, integração, E2E) e qualidade contínua.
  • Evoluir o Developer Experience (DX) com ferramentas internas, templates e automações.
  • Garantir ambientes consistentes e infraestrutura como código (IaC).
  • Estabelecer práticas de SRE: SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, incident management e post-mortems.

Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Talentos

  • Atuar como referência técnica para arquitetos, tech leads e engenheiros sêniores.
  • Desenvolver competências técnicas e comportamentais nos times.
  • Criar cultura de excelência, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Influenciar sem autoridade formal em ambientes matriciais.
  • Facilitar discussões técnicas complexas e resolver conflitos.


O que esperamos de você?

  • Pensa e age a partir das perspectivas dos clientes. Demonstra interesse e curiosidade de conhecer os clientes, seus comportamentos e preferências para atender e superar suas expectativas;
  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.


Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:

  • Graduação Completa em TI e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência de mais de 10 anos em engenharia de software, com pelo menos 5 em liderança técnica sênior.
  • Experiência em ambientes com múltiplas áreas de tecnologia, múltiplos produtos digitais ou plataformas complexas.
  • Histórico comprovado de implementação de governança técnica e padrões corporativos.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas modernas: microsserviços, APIs, event-driven, cloud-native.
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD, automação, observabilidade e DevSecOps.
  • Familiaridade com IA generativa aplicada ao desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos comprovados de desenvolvimento Java e phytom.

title: Lifecycle and Events Marketing Coordinator
description:
About Us

Oxford University Press (OUP), a department of the University of Oxford, has supported education and research for more than 500 years. From supporting children learning to read to advancing global research, our mission is to create the highest quality educational and research resources and make them available worldwide.

Our English Language Teaching (ELT) business in Brazil continues to grow, and we are looking for a Lifecycle and Events Marketing Coordinator to join our Brazil Marketing team.


About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity for a customer-focused and well-organised marketing professional to play a central role in coordinating and delivering marketing activity across Brazil.

The purpose of this role is to coordinate and execute Brazil’s marketing plan, ensuring all activities are shaped by local customer needs and contribute to country revenue growth. The role combines marketing planning, events, campaigns, communications, localisation, and customer lifecycle activity, working closely with Sales, Customer Enablement and Operations.

Reporting to the Managing Director, the Lifecycle and Events Marketing Coordinator will ensure that marketing activity is relevant, well-executed and effectively supports customer engagement across the entire lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the annual Brazil marketing planning process, consolidating inputs, timelines and customer insights
  • Deliver high-quality events, campaigns and communications, ensuring strong execution, participation and effective follow-up
  • Manage the localisation and creation of Brazil-relevant marketing materials, adapting global assets and developing local content as needed
  • Provide the Sales team with timely, accurate and Brazil-relevant materials, information and messaging to support customer conversations
  • Apply customer lifecycle principles across acquisition, onboarding, in-life engagement and renewal, creating or adapting communications where required
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment, clear communication and effective execution of marketing activities
  • Track performance, capture learning and continuously improve marketing effectiveness and customer experience
  • Use marketing and sales tools (including Salesforce, HighSpot, Dotdigital, Eventbrite and Google tools) to plan, deliver and evaluate activities


About You

We are looking for a proactive, collaborative professional who combines strong organisational skills with a clear focus on customer needs and high-quality execution.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Strong customer focus and understanding of the needs of schools, educators and institutions in Brazil
  • Experience coordinating and delivering marketing plans, events, campaigns and communications
  • Ability to adapt global marketing assets and create clear, on-brand and locally relevant materials
  • Experience supporting sales teams with timely, accurate and customer-relevant resources
  • Practical understanding of customer lifecycle stages (acquisition, onboarding, in-life, renewal)
  • Comfortable using marketing and sales platforms and tools to plan, deliver and track activity
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English

Desirable:

  • Knowledge of the Brazilian education and ELT market
  • Experience in B2B and/or education-sector marketing
  • Experience coordinating vendors or event logistics
  • Experience working with global teams or adapting global frameworks to local markets


Why Join Oxford University Press?

At OUPB, you will be part of a purpose-driven organisation with a global mission and local impact. We offer a collaborative environment, opportunities for learning and development, and the chance to shape meaningful marketing activity that supports education across Brazil.

Apply now and help us support learners and educators across Brazil.

title: SAO PAULO/BOGOTA - [HYBRID] - L2 SOC Analyst
description:
About the Company:

As the founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, Quanteam is a consulting firm specializing in Banking, Finance, and Financial Services. Guided by our core values of closeness, teamwork, diversity, and excellence, our team of 1,000 expert consultants, representing 35 different nationalities, collaborates across 10 international offices: Paris, Lyon, New York, Montreal, London, Brussels, Geneva, Lisbon, Porto, and Casablanca.


We are currently seeking a seasoned Security Analyst (L2) to support one of our clients, a leading international financial institution headquartered in Montreal.


Role Overview:

As a Senior SOC Analyst embedded within a 24x7 Security Operations Center, you will be at the forefront of identifying, analyzing, and neutralizing sophisticated cyber threats targeting critical business infrastructure. Beyond routine alert handling, this role focuses on in-depth forensic investigation, proactive threat hunting, and the continuous strengthening of the SOC’s detection and response capabilities. The analyst in this position serves as a technical anchor for the team, guiding junior colleagues and actively contributing to the organization’s overall security posture.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Threat Detection & Incident Response

  • Ownership: Take the lead on high-severity and complex security events, including intrusions involving persistent adversaries, multi-stage attack chains, and advanced malicious payloads.
  • Investigation: Conduct thorough technical analysis across SIEM platforms, endpoint telemetry, and network traffic data to reconstruct attack timelines and uncover root causes.
  • Escalation Support: Serve as the primary escalation point for junior analysts, offering technical validation, investigative direction, and remediation guidance.
  • Documentation: Ensure all incidents, findings, and response actions are precisely recorded in case management systems to support operational continuity and post-event reviews.


2. Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting

  • Content Development: Design, tune, and maintain detection logic, correlation rules, and monitoring dashboards within SIEM platforms to maximize coverage and reduce alert noise.
  • Proactive Hunting: Initiate hypothesis-driven threat hunt campaigns using intelligence feeds, behavioral baselines, and knowledge of adversary tactics drawn from recognized attack frameworks.
  • Automation: Develop and maintain scripts and tooling (Python, Bash) to accelerate investigative workflows, automate data enrichment, and streamline repetitive SOC tasks.


3. Cross-functional Collaboration & SOC Development

  • Teamwork: Partner with adjacent teams (infrastructure, cloud, identity management, incident response) during active security events and broader remediation efforts.
  • Lessons Learned: Actively contribute to post-incident retrospectives, generating actionable recommendations to strengthen security controls and refine processes.
  • Continuous Improvement: Support tooling upgrades, SOC maturity initiatives, and security projects to keep operational capabilities in step with an evolving threat landscape.


Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in a SOC environment or a comparable senior cybersecurity role.
  • Demonstrated expertise with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK), including the authoring of queries, correlation rules, and custom dashboards.
  • Advanced understanding of security technologies spanning network defense (firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxies, VPN), endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), and data security solutions.
  • Solid grounding in incident response lifecycle, log analysis techniques, and packet capture (PCAP) examination.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of core networking protocols and architectures (OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMTP).
  • Thorough understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures, with practical familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux environments, including the ability to identify indicators of compromise and abnormal system behavior.
  • Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) applied to investigation support and process automation.
  • A proactive, adversarial mindset with a continuous drive toward improved threat detection and defense.


Working conditions:

  • Candidate must be located or willing to relocate to Brazil (São Paulo) or Colombia (Bogotá)
  • Hybrid schedule with 3 days on-site per week
  • Participation in on-call rotations and extended coverage hours required
  • Availability for morning or daytime shifts, including weekend assignments as part of 24/7 operations
  • Fluency in English required

title: COORDENADOR DE MARKETING DIGITAL
description:
RESUMO DA DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO:


O Coordenador de Marketing Digital será responsável por planejar, liderar, executar e supervisionar jornadas omnichannel estratégicas que impulsionem resultados expressivos para os produtos e marcas da empresa, alinhadas às estratégias corporativas e aos objetivos de negócios. Essa posição atuará como elo central entre as diversas áreas da organização para conceber e operacionalizar experiências integradas, centradas no cliente.


O profissional será responsável por desenhar jornadas com visão estratégica, selecionando os canais mais adequados, incorporando soluções inovadoras como Inteligência Artificial para acelerar entregas e ampliar o impacto. Além da dimensão estratégica, atuará como referência em UX (Experiência do Usuário), garantindo que cada ponto de contato com o cliente seja coerente, relevante e de alto valor.


A posição também lidera iniciativas digitais voltadas à expansão de mercado, aumento e ativação da base de clientes, campanhas digitais e aproximação com pacientes, além de realizar a gestão da equipe interna e de provedores.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Planejar e liderar jornadas omnichannel estratégicas junto as Áreas Chaves: Mapear, desenhar e implementar jornadas integradas para clientes, conectando os canais definidos pela companhia de forma coerente e estratégica, selecionando canais mais adequados para cada etapa. Orientar a construção das jornadas com base em dados, comportamento do usuário e objetivos de negócio.


  • Promover a integração estratégica entre áreas: Integrar Marketing, Medical, Força de Vendas, ExCom, TI, Regulatório e HQ para co-criar jornadas robustas e viáveis, garantindo a execução integral e alinhadas às iniciativas omnichannel.


  • Incorporar Inteligência Artificial e inovação na aceleração da transformação digital: Identificar, propor e implementar soluções de IA e automação que potencializem as jornadas do cliente, como personalização em escala, assistentes para a força de vendas, análise preditiva e recomendações inteligentes. Avaliar continuamente o cenário de inovação digital e trazer soluções que antecipem tendências e ampliem a vantagem competitiva da empresa.


  • Coordenar a experiência do usuário (UX) nas jornadas digitais: Aplicar metodologias e princípios de UX no desenho das jornadas e interfaces digitais, garantindo que os pontos de contato com clientes sejam intuitivos, acessíveis e centrados nas necessidades do usuário. Colaborar com HQ, TI e fornecedores para implementar melhorias contínuas nas plataformas e canais digitais com base em pesquisas de usabilidade, testes A/B e feedbacks dos usuários.


  • Liderar iniciativas digitais para expansão de mercado e crescimento da base de clientes: Desenvolver e executar estratégias digitais focadas em aquisição de novos clientes, ativação de base e retenção, com ações direcionadas a médicos, farmacêuticos, pacientes e outros stakeholders. Planejar e coordenar campanhas digitais integradas (mídia paga, SEO, e-mail marketing, whatsapp, marketing de conteúdo e redes sociais) alinhadas às prioridades dos produtos e marcas.


  • Promover a aproximação digital com pacientes: Desenvolver iniciativas e programas digitais que fortaleçam o vínculo entre a empresa, suas marcas e os pacientes, contribuindo para a adesão ao tratamento, educação em saúde e engajamento com os produtos. Garantir que as jornadas do paciente sejam construídas com ética, empatia e conformidade regulatória.


  • Analisar dados e monitorar a performance das jornadas e campanhas: Utilizar ferramentas de analytics, CRM e dashboards para monitorar o desempenho das jornadas e campanhas omnichannel, identificando gargalos, oportunidades e pontos de melhoria. Compartilhar insights periódicos com as áreas chave, orientando a tomada de decisão e o redirecionamento das estratégias.


  • Gerir o orçamento da área digital: Controlar o orçamento anual das iniciativas digitais, priorizando investimentos com base no retorno esperado e no alinhamento estratégico. Assegurar que fornecedores, agências e plataformas entreguem dentro dos parâmetros de custo, prazo e qualidade acordados.


  • Coordenar fornecedores, agências e parceiros digitais: Gerenciar o relacionamento com agências criativas, de mídia, tecnologia e parceiros estratégicos, garantindo qualidade nas entregas, cumprimento de prazos e alinhamento com as estratégias da empresa. Elaborar briefings, acompanhar projetos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e entregas.


  • Elaborar planos de treinamento digital para a força de vendas: Desenvolver materiais e dinâmicas de capacitação para a equipe comercial, promovendo a transformação digital e o uso eficaz das ferramentas e canais digitais disponíveis. Apoiar a área de Treinamento na criação de conteúdos que integrem as jornadas digitais à rotina da força de vendas.


  • Realizar a gestão do Jovem Aprendiz: Supervisionar, orientar e desenvolver o Jovem Aprendiz da área de Marketing Digital, garantindo sua integração às atividades do time, seu aprendizado prático e seu desenvolvimento profissional.


CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS:

Experiência:

  • +5 anos de experiência em Marketing Digital, com atuação comprovada em estratégias omnichannel, jornadas do cliente, iniciativas digitais e campanhas de marketing digital.
  • Experiência prévia com design de jornadas e/ou UX (User Experience), com conhecimento de metodologias centradas no usuário.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação de marketing, CRM e plataformas de gestão de jornadas (ex: Salesforce, Veeva ou equivalentes).
  • Experiência com gestão de fornecedores, agências digitais e parceiros tecnológicos.
  • Desejável: experiência no setor farmacêutico, saúde ou life sciences.


Formação Acadêmica:


  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Comunicação Social, Administração de Empresas, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas.


  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Marketing Digital, UX/CX, Transformação Digital, Gestão de Produto Digital ou áreas afins será um diferencial relevante.


Idioma:


  • Espanhol: Intermediário
  • Inglês Intermediário


Conhecimentos Específicos:


  • Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de analytics (Power BI, Looker Studio ou equivalentes).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de UX/UI: pesquisa com usuários, wireframes, testes de usabilidade, jornada do usuário.
  • Conhecimento em automação de marketing, segmentação de audiências e personalização em escala.
  • Noções de Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao marketing.
  • Domínio de métricas e KPIs digitais (CAC, LTV, NPS digital, taxa de conversão, engajamento, ROI de campanhas).
  • Pacote Office com PowerPoint e Excel nível intermediário/ avançado.
  • Conhecimento em SEO, SEM, LLMs, marketing de conteúdo e estratégias inbound.

title: Data Engineer (Azure/Databricks)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and scale modern data solutions using Azure Databricks. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of data pipelines, drive best practices in data architecture, and ensure high-quality, reliable data is delivered to support analytics and business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Azure Databricks, ensuring alignment with lakehouse architecture and medallion design patterns
  • Design and implement end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from diverse sources, transform it based on business requirements, and deliver it to downstream consumers
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain Apache Spark and PySpark jobs to efficiently process large-scale datasets
  • Implement data quality frameworks, validation processes, and monitoring/alerting systems to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and availability
  • Drive best practices by developing reusable frameworks, libraries, and standardized approaches for data engineering across the team
  • Optimize query performance and resource utilization within Azure environments to ensure cost efficiency and scalability
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of data pipelines, workflows, and architecture while ensuring compliance with security and governance policies
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD processes, and promote engineering excellence within the data organization


Need to Haves


  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including at least 2+ years working with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark
  • Strong programming skills in Python and PySpark, along with advanced SQL (especially Spark SQL)
  • Proven experience building configuration-driven ETL pipelines and orchestrating workflows using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, or Apache Airflow
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling and data vault methodologies
  • Hands-on experience with Delta Lake and lakehouse/medallion architecture patterns
  • Experience with Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, REST APIs, SFTP, and Azure Key Vault
  • Proficiency in Git for version control, including branching strategies, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with CI/CD practices for deploying and managing data pipelines
  • Fluent English to interact with international teams


Nice to Haves


  • Experience working with large-scale distributed data systems and performance optimization techniques
  • Familiarity with data quality, testing, and observability frameworks
  • Experience supporting analytics or data science teams with curated and accessible datasets
  • Exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid cloud data environments
  • Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance best practices in cloud platforms

title: Marketing Manager - Strategic Campaigns and Influencers
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Strategic Campaigns & KOL area is a key part of our Marketing team, responsible for planning, structuring and executing high-impact campaigns on mass media channels (TV and OOH) and social media (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok) and managing/negotiating partnerships with influencers relevant to SHEIN. Our team works in a multidisciplinary way, coordinating with areas such as Content, Brand Experience, PR, GR and Marketplace to ensure integrated, consistent and results-oriented communication. In addition, we are responsible analyzing performance metrics and optimizing return on investment, contributing directly to strengthening and expanding our brand presence in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop strategies for high-impact campaigns aligned with brand goals and market trends.
  • Managing budgets and schedules, coordinating internal teams and external suppliers.
  • Plan, produce and execute campaigns across different channels, including social media, TV, OOH and other offline media.
  • Ensuring the integration of all touchpoints to maximize the impact of the campaign.
  • Select KOLs aligned with the brand.
  • Negotiate exclusive collaborations or special collections with high-performance KOLs.
  • Evaluate the performance of each KOL (engagement, reach, ROI, GMV).
  • Optimize strategies to improve impact and results, with a focus on engagement and sales.
  • Monitor ROI results, engagement, conversion rate and other relevant indicators.
  • Generate periodic analyses and data-based recommendations to optimize campaigns in real time.
  • Prepare executive presentations for stakeholders, highlighting learnings and insights for future campaigns.
  • Develop detailed briefs for internal teams (creatives, media, etc.) and external suppliers.
  • Aligning objectives, themes and schedules, ensuring visual and message uniformity.
  • Monitor the entire production process (shooting, recording, editing), ensuring quality and deadlines.


Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Administration, Communication or related field.
  • 5+ years in marketing campaign management, including influencer/KOL initiatives and large-scale campaigns.
  • Experience in media production (TV, video, OOH) and coordination of suppliers/studios.
  • Previous work in international contexts or with global teams is a plus.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) - essential for global interfaces.
  • Solid knowledge of Fashion
  • Solid knowledge of digital marketing, social media and market trends.
  • Excellence in data analysis and metrics for campaign optimization and KOL performance.
  • Leadership of cross-functional teams.
  • Organization and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines.
  • Strategic vision and creative thinking.
  • Communication and relationship skills with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Adaptability and problem-solving in dynamic environments

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !


Job Description

We are seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior Manager to lead our Big Data and Consumer Market Insights (CMI) initiatives, playing a pivotal role in translating complex consumer data into actionable insights that shape business strategy. As a key team member, you’ll analyze consumer behavior, identify trends, and drive data-based decisions, aligning closely with cross-functional teams to enhance the customer journey and address critical business needs. This role is an excellent opportunity for a data leader with strong analytical and communication skills who thrives on influencing business outcomes.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive big data strategy that aligns with business objectives and leverages cutting-edge technologies (cloud platforms, machine learning, AI).
  • Oversee the collection, processing, and analysis of diverse data sources, including consumer interactions, product usage, social media, and market trends.
  • Apply advanced analytics to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities that address business challenges and drive innovation.
  • Develop predictive models and algorithms to anticipate consumer behavior and market dynamics.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (product, marketing, sales) to translate data insights into actionable strategies and product roadmaps. By understanding business pain points and develop data-driven solutions that support organizational goals.
  • Communicate complex data findings in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences. And drive the creation and maintenance of dashboards and reporting tools that allow business units to make informed, data-backed decisions.
  • Stay ahead of the curve by exploring and evaluating emerging technologies in big data and analytics (e.g., data lakes, real-time analytics). Utilize advanced data analytics techniques (predictive modeling, machine learning, etc.) to forecast consumer trends and identify growth opportunities.
  • Build a thriving Big Data Community across LATAM: Foster a collaborative network of data professionals across Samsung subsidiaries in Latin America. This community will serve as a platform for knowledge sharing, best practice development, and driving a data-driven culture across the region. You will empower these individuals to become evangelists for data-driven decision-making within their respective operations, with a strong focus on achieving measurable business results and contributing to Samsung's overall success in the LATAM market.
  • Design and execute innovative market research studies (surveys, focus groups, customer interviews) to gather qualitative and quantitative data on consumer needs and preferences. And lead data analysis strategies that extract and interpret patterns in consumer data to understand behaviors, needs, and preferences.
  • Analyze market research data to identify key trends, competitive landscape, and opportunities for differentiation. Utilize advanced data analytics techniques (predictive modeling, machine learning, etc.) to forecast consumer trends and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the consumer electronics market, emerging trends (e.g., IoT, smart home), and Samsung's competitive positioning.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to integrate consumer insights into product development, marketing campaigns, and go-to-market strategies. By identify business pain points and develop data-driven solutions that support organizational goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Statistics or other relevant areas.
  • Experience in a data-driven role, with leadership responsibilities.
  • Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data insights to business objectives, anticipate future trends, and identify opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • A deep understanding of consumer behavior, empathy for customer needs, and a passion for uncovering their motivations and pain points.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Able to convey complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, build consensus, and influence stakeholders.
  • A strong team player with proven ability to build relationships, foster a data-driven culture, and collaborate effectively across departments.
  • Driven to achieve goals, exceed expectations, and deliver impactful results that contribute to Samsung's success. Adept at using data to solve real business problems, with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
  • Strong organizational skills and experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Proven expertise in big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark, Hive, etc.), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), statistical analysis tools (R, Python), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI). Advanced Excel.
  • Advanced English skills, Spanish will be considered a plus.


Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team : Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges : Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future : Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact : Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.


Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Global networking and collaboration



At Samsung, we want you to be yourself! We prioritize fairness and will never request personal information unrelated to the selection process, such as marital status, age, gender, religion, or political opinions.

title: Marketing Coordinator/Specialist
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator/Specialist who will be responsible to lead high-impact growth projects with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. This role blends quantitative rigor, qualitative judgment, and creativity in a project-based environment where no two days look the same. It is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to grow rapidly by solving meaningful business challenges. You will partner closely with the Marketing Lead on high-priority initiatives and be expected to demonstrate strong leadership, sound judgment, and structured problem-solving.


If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Exclusivity contract required.


Responsibilities:

  • Growth Strategy: Partner with the Marketing Lead to structure complex business challenges into components, develop and validate hypotheses with data, and shape solutions with justifiable ROI.
  • Project Management: Independently scope, plan, and execute multiple concurrent projects end-to-end, leading cross-functional teams and owning the final outcomes.
  • Performance Analysis: Assess project effectiveness and ROI to inform future decisions, optimize resource allocation, and improve marketing efficiency.
  • Player & Product Insight: Build a deep understanding of the game and players.


Main job requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Candidates from Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative disciplines with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience: 3–6 years of experience in marketing, growth, or performance marketing, with a track record of initiating and driving projects end-to-end. Candidates with non-marketing backgrounds and/or fewer than 3 years of experience will be considered, provided strong transferable experience from the following environments (e.g., MBB, BB IB, PE, VC, or high-growth startups).
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools and workflows effectively, including AI-enabled automation, agent-based ways of working, etc.
  • Passion for Gaming: Active gamer with a genuine interest in gaming culture and content.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken.
  • Tools: Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, X/VLOOKUP, and structured data handling.
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

title: Product Manager (Dados) - Especialista
description:
Product Manager de Dados - Especialista

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Product Manager de Dados, seu papel será de liderança estratégica, definindo a visão e a agenda de produtos de dados em um escopo mais amplo, como um spoke ou portfólio. Você será responsável por guiar a estratégia de dados, garantindo que os produtos desenvolvidos estejam alinhados aos objetivos de negócio de alto nível e impulsionem a inovação. Sua atuação envolverá a gestão de portfólio, a influência sobre equipes e stakeholders sem autoridade hierárquica direta, e a capacidade de traduzir a complexidade técnica em insights acionáveis para a liderança Executiva.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Demonstrar fluência em dados, compreendendo modelagem, pipelines e produtos de dados, mesmo sem atuação direta em código;
  • Aplicar metodologias de gestão de portfólio, como WSJF e OKRs, na priorização e direcionamento das iniciativas;
  • Construir e evoluir roadmaps estratégicos, conectando entregas de dados aos objetivos do negócio;
  • Atuar com frameworks ágeis em escala (SAFe, PI Planning, ART), orquestrando iniciativas complexas;
  • Interpretar dashboards, KPIs e métricas de negócio para embasar decisões e priorizações;
  • Apoiar discussões com base em noções de arquitetura de dados e IA, questionando e validando soluções propostas;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de gestão como Jira, Confluence e Miro no dia a dia;
  • Atuar com visão de dono(a) do negócio, construindo uma agenda estratégica de dados orientada a valor;
  • Influenciar stakeholders sem autoridade hierárquica direta, promovendo alinhamento entre áreas;
  • Traduzir complexidade técnica em linguagem executiva e vice-versa;
  • Construir relações de confiança com lideranças e times técnicos, mesmo em cenários de ambiguidade;
  • Identificar sinergias entre áreas e antecipar possíveis silos, com visão sistêmica do negócio.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

title: Arquitetura de Soluções Sênior- Afirmativa para Mulheres
description:

description:

title: Procurement Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).


Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.


Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.


How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role, please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates, only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

description:

DIA-A-DIA

Agimos como donos em tudo que fazemos e nossas entregas são únicas. Aqui, você encontrará um time apaixonado, focado em oferecer a melhor experiência para o cliente e com uma inquietude constante. Nosso sonho é grande e a vontade de fazer acontecer é ainda maior. Atuamos dentro de uma cultura de transparência e empatia e valorizamos pessoas proativas e auto gerenciáveis.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:


ANALISTA DE MARKETING SR | GESTÃO DE PROJETOS


O desafio da pessoa Analista de Marketing SR é organizar a rotina da área, conduzindo a gestão dos múltiplos projetos do time para que tudo aconteça dentro dos prazos, orçamentos e padrões de qualidade. Senso de dono, inconformismo, vontade de fazer acontecer e fazer diferente são a chave para o cargo.


Confira as principais atividades desta vaga:

  • Estruturar e acompanhar cronogramas e logística, distribuindo responsabilidades e assegurando entregas sincronizadas e no prazo;
  • Consolidar informações de cada projeto, criando e monitorando indicadores das etapas e propondo ajustes sempre que necessário;
  • Antecipar riscos e desenhar planos de ação para manter o fluxo dos trabalhos;
  • Revisar rotinas e propor melhorias que elevem a eficiência e qualidade das entregas da área;
  • Coordenar as tratativas com fornecedores para obter melhores negociações de orçamentos e prazos, garantindo a viabilidade da produção sem comprometer a qualidade;
  • Acompanhar e gerenciar o budget dos projetos, com foco em otimizar a alocação de recursos;
  • Acompanhamento da produção em diferentes etapas, garantindo que os materiais e acabamentos estejam alinhados com o conceito da ativação;
  • Participar de reuniões com os clientes para aprovar diversas ideias;
  • Revisar periodicamente os processos, para que seja possível propor mudanças de rotas, automações e inovações.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Curtiu?! Vamos em frente, entenda o que esperamos de você:

  • Pelo menos 4 anos de experiência em gestão de projetos de marketing, trade marketing e/ou ativações, trabalhando com grandes contas;
  • Capacidade de gerenciar diferentes tarefas e projetos simultaneamente;

title: QA Engineer
description:

Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world. We are continuing to grow and are looking for an QA Automation Engineer.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Proficient English verbal communication skills

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

Job Summary

  • We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Manager in Retail Marketing to join our dynamic team.
  • The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and leading a team of promoters and store leaders, ensuring they effectively drive brand visibility, reinforce brand awareness, and achieve sales targets for consumer electronics categories, especially Visual Displays, in retail partner stores.
  • This role requires a deep understanding of retail dynamics, consumer behavior, and the ability to collaborate across functions to deliver impactful results.



Areas of Responsibilities in this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Developing and executing strategies to enhance brand visibility and reinforce brand awareness in retail partner stores;
  • Collaborating with retail partners to optimize product placement, promotions, and in-store experiences that align with Samsung's brand identity;
  • Ensuring consistent brand representation and messaging across all retail channels.
  • Leading the planning and execution of retail marketing campaigns, including point-of-sale materials, stores activations, and events;
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (sales, product management, creative) to ensure seamless execution of marketing plans;
  • Leading, mentoring, and managing a team of promoters and store leaders, ensuring they are well-trained and equipped to represent the brand effectively;
  • Monitoring campaign performance and adjust strategies as needed to achieve desired outcomes;
  • Monitoring and analyzing sales performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement;
  • Working closely with promoters and store leaders to ensure the achievement of sales targets for consumer electronics categories;
  • Providing actionable insights and recommendations to drive sales growth and maximize ROI.
  • Tracking and analyzing key performance metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of retail marketing activities;
  • Preparing detailed reports on team performance, campaign results, and sales achievements for senior management;
  • Providing actionable insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Overseeing the allocation and management of retail marketing budgets to ensure cost-effective solutions;
  • Monitoring expenses and ensuring alignment with financial targets and budget execution.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Soid experience in retail marketing, with a proven track record in the electronics or consumer goods industry.
  • Strong understanding of retail dynamics, consumer behavior, and market trends.
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and performance measurement tools.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions.
  • Fluence in English is mandatory.
  • Domain in MS office package to manage big data bases in Excel and presentation creations in Power point.
  • Strong story telling creation and presentation capabilities (in Portuguese and English).

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

title: Director Integrated Growth
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Integrated Marketing Director to lead and scale growth engine in Brazil. This leader will own the full user growth funnel—from acquisition to retention—while building a high-performing team across User Operations, Campaign Marketing .

This role requires a strategic operator who combines data-driven decision-making, strong execution, and team leadership to drive sustainable, scalable growth in a highly competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

Growth Marketing Strategy & Execution

  • Own and drive the end-to-end growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and reactivation
  • Define and execute multi-channel growth initiatives (paid media, CRM, partnerships, organic, referrals)
  • Identify and scale high-ROI growth levers through experimentation and rapid iteration
  • Lead market-specific strategies tailored to Brazil’s competitive and cultural landscape

Funnel Ownership & Performance Management

  • Build and optimize the full-funnel growth model with clear KPIs and targets
  • Drive improvements across key metrics such as:
  • User acquisition cost (CAC)
  • Activation rate
  • Retention
  • Lifetime value (LTV)
  • Establish growth dashboards and reporting cadence for executive visibility
  • Implement structured experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, cohort analysis)

Data, Insights & Customer Understanding

  • Leverage data to generate actionable user insights and inform growth strategies
  • Partner with Product and Data teams to improve tracking, attribution, and analytics infrastructure
  • Translate insights into targeted campaigns and lifecycle strategies
  • Champion a customer-centric approach across all growth initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Operations, Commercial, and Tech teams to align on growth priorities
  • Influence roadmap decisions to improve user experience and conversion
  • Drive alignment between global strategy and local market execution in Brazil

Experimentation & Innovation

  • Build a culture of test-and-learn with rapid iteration cycles
  • Identify new growth opportunities including:
  • New channels and partnerships
  • Product-led growth initiatives
  • Local market innovations
  • Continuously benchmark against top-performing players in Brazil


Qualifications

  • Robust experience in Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing, or Product Growth
  • Proven track record of scaling user growth in high-growth tech companies
  • Experience managing large, cross-functional teams
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in SQL, data tools, and experimentation frameworks
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian market dynamics and consumer behavior
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive business outcomes
  • Background in product-led growth or lifecycle marketing
  • Experience in hyper-growth or international expansion environments
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience designing and developing manual tests for web and mobile (iOS and android) with a stronger emphasis on web experience

  • Ability to provide & received direct and regular self improvement feedback with peers
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field.

title: Talent Knowledge Designer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Talent Knowledge Content Designer position focuses on being the sole owner of the Talent Acquisition knowledge ecosystem, with real autonomy to shape how hundreds of employees access and experience critical process information. This role involves transforming raw process knowledge into beautifully structured, visually compelling Confluence pages that people actually want to read. You'll collaborate directly with a forward-thinking Learning team that is actively revamping how knowledge is built and shared, with exposure to tools like EdApp, NotebookLM, and AI-assisted content creation.


Key responsibilities


- Owning and administering the TA Confluence space, maintaining structure, page hierarchy, naming conventions, and ensuring all content is up to date, correctly formatted, and easy to navigate for all users.

- Receiving process documentation from the Process Documentation Expert and transforming it into polished, structured Confluence pages using visual aids, diagrams, workflows, and clear formatting that makes content engaging and easy to consume.

- Creating visual content including process flow diagrams, quick-reference guides, infographics, and summary decks to complement written documentation and reinforce comprehension.

- Prioritizing updates in Confluence based on usage and impact.

- Researching and proposing new tools, templates, or formats that improve knowledge accessibility and the overall visual quality of TA documentation for both new joiners and current employees.


Requirements


- Content Design Experience: 2-4 years of experience in content design, knowledge management, instructional design, or equivalent roles.

- Platform Management: 2+ years managing or publishing documentation platforms, with Confluence strongly preferred.

- Visual Content Creation: Proven experience creating visual content including diagrams, process flows, and infographics.

- Process Translation: Experience translating complex process documentation into clear, engaging content.

- Confluence Proficiency: Proficiency with Confluence including publishing, formatting, and structuring spaces and pages.

- Design Tools: Intermediate level experience with visual design tools such as Canva, Figma, or equivalent.

- Diagramming Tools: Experience with diagramming tools such as Lucidchart, draw.io, Miro, or similar.

- Google Workspace: Proficiency with Google Workspace including Docs, Slides, and Drive.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.


Additional skills preferred


- Industry Experience: Previous experience in an HR Tech, People Ops, or Learning & Development environment.

- Project Coordination: Experience coordinating cross-functional content projects or managing a content backlog.

- IA and UX Principles: Familiarity with Information Architecture (IA) or UX writing principles.

- Learning Tools: Knowledge of EdApp, NotebookLM, or similar tools.

- AI Tools: Experience with AI-powered content tools.

- Technical Skills: Basic HTML/CSS for Confluence page customization.

- Video Production: Video editing or screen recording experience with Loom, Camtasia, or similar tools.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Auxilia nas atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento, contas a receber e cobrança, atuando sob supervisão para garantir o processamento preciso e pontual das transações de crédito e contas a receber. Contribui para a eficiência e eficácia das operações do departamento.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver ferramentas de cibersegurança: Criar e manter scanners de vulnerabilidades, monitoramento de ameaças e integrações SIEM para suporte operacional ao time de ops.
  • Suporte cross-team dedicado: Atuar como ponte entre times de dev (segurança em código) e ops (operação de ferramentas), realizando code reviews, threat modeling e automação de conformidade (OWASP Top 10, CIS Benchmarks).
  • Monitoramento e resposta a incidentes: Configurar e otimizar alertas em ambientes cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), com ênfase em IAM, WAF e zero-trust para ferramentas críticas.
  • Evolução de processos: Documentar pipelines seguros, treinar equipes em IaC (Terraform/Helm) e contribuir para políticas de segurança em contêineres (Kubernetes/Docker).
  • Otimização contínua: Analisar métricas de segurança em produção, propor melhorias em ferramentas customizadas e garantir conformidade LGPD/PCI-DSS.
  • Identificar riscos e liderar soluções de segurança end-to-end.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Possuir certificações CSSLP, CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist) ou AWS/GCP/Azure Security Specialty.
  • Experiência com DevSecOps e suporte cross-team.
  • Proficiência em CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions) e IaC (Terraform, Helm, Ansible) para integração de segurança shift-left.
  • Experiência com SAST/DAST/SCA (SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx, Snyk), scanners de contêineres (Clair, Grype) e runtime security (Falco).
  • Experiência com l inguagens e infraestrutura: Python ou Go para automação de ferramentas de segurança; Kubernetes/Docker para orquestração segura; scripts em Bash/PowerShell.
  • Experiência com Cloud Nativa: Hands-on em AWS (Security Hub, GuardDuty, IAM, WAF, Secrets Manager), GCP ou Azure (Defender for Cloud), com foco em políticas de zero-trust e detecção de ameaças.
  • Domínio em OWASP Top 10, CIS Benchmarks, pipelines seguros e conformidade LGPD/PCI-DSS/GDPR.
  • Experiência com equipes multidisciplinares, atuando como ponte entre Desenvolvedores, Ops e Stakeholders.


Informações adicionais

  • Experiência com PCI-DSS e ISO 27001.
  • Experiência com ferramentas: Sysdig, ELK Stack, Hashicorp Vault, PKI e Certificados, Segurança em Terminais.
  • Certificações OSCP, CEH ou DevSecOps (ex.: Docker CAP, Kubernetes Security).

Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS®, Brach’s®, Jelly Belly®, SweeTARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:


  • Formação superior completa em áreas de Tecnologia da Informação ou correlatas;
  • Experiência com processos de negócios, envolvendo os assuntos de vendas, preços, descontos, impostos, análise de crédito, faturamento, nota fiscal eletrônica e contabilização;

Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.


A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC ).


Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

title: AI Pre-sales Solution Manager (Brazil)

Minimum 8 years of experience in enterprise pre-sales, solutions consulting, or technical consulting roles

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Senior Quality Analyst (Gen AI)


Garantir a qualidade em sistemas de IA Generativa é um desafio único: as respostas podem ser não-determinísticas. Sua missão será desenhar e implementar estratégias de testes que validem não apenas o código, mas a precisão, segurança e confiabilidade dos nossos sistemas agênticos.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Estratégia de Testes de IA: Criar frameworks para validar saídas de LLMs, combatendo alucinações, vieses e garantindo a aderência ao contexto.
  • Automação: Desenvolver e manter scripts de automação de testes (E2E, API e Integração) utilizando ferramentas como Playwright ou Cypress.
  • Shift-left Testing: Atuar desde a fase de requisitos para garantir que a qualidade seja pensada no início do desenvolvimento.
  • Testes de Performance e Segurança: Validar a resiliência das integrações com modelos de IA e a segurança contra vulnerabilidades como prompt injection.
  • Monitoramento de Qualidade: Definir e acompanhar métricas de qualidade e bugs, reportando resultados para o time global.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência avançada em automação de testes e ferramentas de QA.
  • Conhecimento em Python (para scripts de teste e validação de dados).
  • Inglês Avançado: Capacidade de interagir e reportar resultados para times internacionais.
  • Desejável: Experiência anterior testando aplicações que consomem APIs de LLM (OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).

title: International Treasury Coordinator
description:
Forno de Minas is a leading Brazilian food company with a strong heritage, recognized brands, and a growing international footprint. As the company expands its operations in the U.S. and Europe, financial governance, liquidity control, and operational excellence are critical to sustaining growth. We offer a collaborative environment with high exposure, autonomy, and direct interaction with senior leadership.


About the role


This is a highly specialized international treasury role , designed for a senior, autonomous professional.

The International Treasury Coordinator will operate independently , owning treasury, cash flow, and international banking operations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe .

This is not a transactional AP role .

It is a position with low payment volume but very high operational and compliance complexity , requiring strong judgment, technical depth, and end-to-end ownership.


Key responsibilities

Cash Flow & Liquidity Management

  • Build, manage, and continuously monitor short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts (including 13-week cash flow)
  • Ensure liquidity and funding availability for international operations
  • Analyze variances, assumptions, and scenarios impacting cash position

International Payments & Banking Operations

  • Execute and manage international payments across U.S. and European banking systems
  • Operate payment methods such as ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, wire transfers , and international payroll-related payments
  • Navigate banking environments without PIX or boletos
  • Manage FX transactions, payment cut-offs, bank holidays, and country-specific rules
  • Maintain strong relationships with international banks and service providers
  • Negotiate banking fees and service conditions when applicable

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end international AP and AR flows, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness
  • Partner with Accounting and local providers (e.g., Portugal accounting team) for validation and execution
  • Ensure payments align with accounting, tax, and contractual requirements
  • Apply strong governance, internal controls, and compliance standards

Cross-functional Partnership

  • Work closely with HR (international payrolls and benefits), Marketing (costs and campaigns), Accounting , FP&A , and Commercial
  • Understand accounting classifications (OPEX vs. CAPEX) and financial impacts
  • Act as a key finance partner in international operations


Profile we are looking for

  • A senior, autonomous, and highly reliable professional
  • Comfortable operating alone , without constant follow-ups
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Able to manage complex international routines with precision
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and resilient in a corporate governance environment
  • Strong communication skills to interact with global stakeholders


Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Fluent English (mandatory / non-negotiable)
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Treasury or International Finance
  • Proven experience with international payments , especially in the U.S.
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow management (build, monitor, analyze)
  • Strong understanding of financial mathematics
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP and/or Datasul – TOTVS)
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance


Nice to have

  • Experience with European banking operations
  • Spanish proficiency
  • Prior exposure to multinational or international business environments


Why join Forno de Minas

  • Strategic international role with high visibility
  • Opportunity to build and structure international treasury operations
  • High level of autonomy and trust
  • Direct interaction with senior leadership
  • Exposure to global financial operations and decision-making

title: Incident Manager (Forensics) Specialist
description:
Incident Manager (Forensics) Specialist


Overview

The Specialist, Information Security - Forensics is part of a global team and is responsible for incident response of cyber security incidents that are associated with our businesses, clients, and vendors; is technically skilled and ensures incident containment, remediation, and closure. This individual will be expected to work closely with the legal, data privacy, business, and client teams. They should be comfortable with interacting with senior executives, including C-level staff.


Responsibilities:

Incident Leadership

  • Serve as the Incident Commander, leading the full lifecycle of cybersecurity incident investigations and response efforts.
  • Coordinate cross-functional communication during high-severity incidents, ensuring rapid containment and clarity across teams.
  • Present concise, accurate written and oral reports to executive and operational leadership.

Forensic Analysis & Investigation

  • Analyze compromised or potentially compromised systems using advanced forensic tools and methodologies.
  • Conduct complex forensic investigations into system breaches, data leaks, and architectural weaknesses.
  • Coordinate evidence and data collection to ensure thorough and reliable incident documentation.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare detailed security incident reports that transform technical findings into actionable insights for decision-makers.
  • Document investigation steps, timelines, technical observations, and remediation impacts with precision and clarity.

Threat Intelligence & Continuous Learning

  • Maintain current knowledge of attacker TTPs, advanced persistent threats, emerging tools, and incident response best practices.
  • Apply threat intelligence insights to strengthen investigative techniques and enhance incident detection capabilities.

Technical Guidance & Support

  • Provide expert technical guidance to teams on incident monitoring, triage, response workflows, threat and vulnerability management, and security analysis.
  • Mentor team members and support growth in incident response competencies across the organization.

Process Optimization & Strategic Direction

  • Identify and drive opportunities to improve incident management efficiency and response workflows at scale.
  • Champion the integration of automation and AI-driven tools to accelerate detection, triage, and resolution.
  • Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of the company’s cybersecurity and incident response programs.


Qualifications:

  • EDR Experience- CrowdStrike and/or SentinelOne with experience investigating and analyzing malware and other malicious activity.
  • Experience with forensics tools such as FTK, EnCase, Autopsy to collect and analyze file system artifacts, process history, application artifacts, memory collection and analysis for physical and cloud systems (Windows, Mac, Linux).
  • 4 or more years of experience in an analytical role of either forensics analyst (Linux, Windows, or MacOS), threat analyst, incident response, SOC analyst, or security engineer/ consultant.
  • Experience with cloud environments such as: Azure, AWS, GCP – knowing how to collect and analyze logs from Guard Duty/ Defender and CloudTrail, etc.
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK or related frameworks.
  • Experience developing and managing incident response programs with focus on efficiency through AI development.
  • Strong communication skills with confidence leading Incident Response calls with different stakeholders; followed by producing detailed incident reports.
  • Proficient insocial engineering, phishing, and related fraud schemes.
  • Strong general knowledge of security concepts and expertise in network and web application security issue s.
  • Experience with a scripting language such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or other scripting language in an incident handling environment.

title: Head of Merchant Growth (CS)
description:
Role Summary

As the Merchant Operations Manager - Merchant Growth , you will drive the growth and success of merchant partners on Keeta's platform through data-driven strategies and multi-dimensional optimization. You will leverage traffic allocation, marketing campaigns, menu optimization, and targeted initiatives to help merchants achieve sustainable growth. In this strategic role, you will develop and execute merchant segmentation strategies, collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement growth initiatives, and continuously optimize the merchant experience to maximize platform value.


Key Responsibilities

1. Merchant Growth Strategy & Segmentation

  • Develop and implement comprehensive growth strategies for merchant partners, utilizing traffic optimization, marketing campaigns, menu enhancement, and operational improvements.
  • Create merchant segmentation frameworks based on performance, category, and potential to deliver targeted growth strategies.

2. Data-Driven Growth Optimization

  • Analyze traffic patterns and customer behavior to design and execute optimal traffic allocation strategies that maximize merchant visibility and acquisition.
  • Leverage performance data to develop and optimize marketing campaigns across in-app and external channels, driving merchant growth and engagement.
  • Use conversion analytics to identify optimization opportunities and implement solutions that improve merchant performance across the customer journey.

3. Competitive Intelligence & Market Insights

  • Monitor competitor strategies, pricing models, and market trends to inform merchant growth recommendations.
  • Provide actionable insights on market dynamics and competitive positioning to help merchants optimize their offerings.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Operations teams to implement growth strategies and optimize platform features.
  • Collaborate with merchant management teams to align growth initiatives with merchant needs and capabilities.
  • Drive end-to-end execution of growth projects, from strategy development to implementation and measurement.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or related field.
  • Solid experience in e-commerce, platform operations, or merchant growth, preferably in food delivery or similar sectors.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, BI tools) and performance tracking.
  • Experience with digital marketing optimization and campaign management.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across functions.
  • Fluent English for cross-border collaboration.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in food delivery or on-demand platforms where merchant growth is critical for platform success.
  • Background in merchant operations, growth strategy with a track record of driving measurable results.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with experience in A/B testing, experimentation, and data-driven decision making.
  • Project management skills with the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives from strategy to execution.


Why Join Keeta?

  • Direct Merchant Impact: Your strategies will directly help thousands of merchants grow and succeed on our platform.
  • Growth at Scale: Work on complex growth challenges across multiple markets and merchant segments in a high-impact role.
